title: Beautiful day at Montserrat
text: Jordy was an excellent tour guide. It is about an hour from Barcelona and the monastery is stunning and beautiful to see. The furnicular ride is amazing and the walk down has so many sites along the way.
author: Marianne_R

title: Amazing!
text: Thank you Frank for the amazing tour! The view was spectacular, the hike so enjoyable, and our tour guide Frank also provided a lot of history and information. I really enjoyed the tour!
author: Zhefan_W

title: Well done
text: Our guide, Mark, was excellent- attentive, knowledgeable, communicative, and timely. Beautiful area.
author: Jeanne_D

title: Perfect day trip from Barcelona
text: What a perfect day we had on this tour. Since we had been in Barcelona a couple of times, we wanted to try something different. Our guide, Juan, was so knowledgeable about the area plus it was obvious he had a deep love and respect for nature. This tour combined hiking, sightseeing, and shopping, it was well coordinated and honestly just fun. There were only 8 of us the group so it was just perfect. I highly recommend this tour.
author: Holly_S

title: Great place to visit
text: Juan and Jordin were wonderful tour guides. We are glad we decided to go to Montserrat with a guide as opposed to by ourselves. It is a beautiful place to visit. The views are spectacular. I would highly recommend it!
author: Moniyah_K

title: Professionally done
text: Well organized, interesting, exactly what we were looking for.   Just enough information, beautiful views, excellent tour guie
author: jonathan_d

title: Awesome tour
text: Great tour, James our guide was excellent. Very good driver (which is hard to find in Spain). Tour was excellent and really nice with just 8 people. James was very knowledgeable. Would do it again!
author: bobC5572PT

title: Monserrat
text: Everyone should be so lucky to have a guide like Frank he was amazing. We did the hike with him and it was fantastic. We’re comfortable shoes we did.

title: Beautiful views and great service
text: Our host Frank was awesome! Great driver, very knowledgeable, flexible!  Pick up worked out as well!!  I’d absolutely recommend this tour and Frank as your host!!
